proposed_change.implementation: Pass headed:true explicitly in Scrape acceptance. At existing Browser.getBrowserCommandLine ownership verification, assert a requested headed run has no --headless or --headless=* argument; emit only requested mode, observed headless boolean and match verdict. Never emit full command line or profile path. Do not change the default for every caller.
proposed_change.feasibility: Uses existing headed option, existing owned Chrome executable, existing hosted macos-15 runner and existing CDP command. No new runtime, permission, screenshot entitlement or browser approval is required by this code change; actual hosted GUI availability remains a runtime preflight observation, not assumed proof.
proposed_change.guards: Execute actual caller-to-spawn seam and command-line verifier with controlled process transport. Omit headed:true and inject --headless=new into observed argv as separate mutants: both must fail. Check unrelated headless callers retain supported mode. No source-string-only test as completion.
proposed_change.native_test: Keep product244/artifact11315305224, member identity/org, browser/runtime, width, resource limits and visibility/context gates fixed. Verify observed headed=true before authentication. One controlled run; successful auth foreground is a D133 discriminator, not completed Scrape acceptance. Reach existing media assertions only if foreground passes.
proposed_change.if_still_hidden: Stop before any hidden-panel acceptance click. Smallest missing observation becomes the spawned Chrome process-owned browser frame with toolbar/panel boundary before recovery, plus existing renderer visibility. Current Page.captureScreenshot is insufficient. Validate any OS window-capture capability on the owned fixture first; if unavailable, report unmeasured rather than adding permissions or claiming native exposure.
proposed_change.toolbar_recovery: A trusted native toolbar close/reopen is a reasonable next intervention only after a headed window and visible toolbar affordance are actually identified. Current trusted fixture open already returns success without restoring the renderer in headless mode. Do not add another open/activate loop, native coordinate guess or DOM click of a hidden panel. Keep it out of the single-variable headed experiment.

siblings.class_finding: The shared default allows callers named native acceptance to run headless. Other omitted/conditional callers exist, but their physical foreground contracts were not audited in this lane; no blanket claim of defects or broad change.
